title: Air Handler Runtime Before Filter Threshold
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hvacfilter:reading
| search runtime_to_threshold_hr=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(runtime_to_threshold_hr) as avg_runtime_to_threshold_hr by _time unit_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks air handler runtime before filter threshold over time and breaks it out by unit.
value: Runtime to threshold shows whether one unit is consuming filters at an unexpectedly fast pace.
implementation: Send air handler runtime before filter threshold events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of air handler runtime before filter threshold by unit.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how air handler runtime before filter threshold changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
